title: The Deposition
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Deposition,' Michael prepares for and participates in a deposition related to Jan's lawsuit, revealing details about their relationship and facing various conflicts and humorous moments. The episode explores office dynamics, personal relationships, and legal proceedings, with characters navigating tensions and humorous exchanges throughout the day.
